list.title: Treatment:
list.snippet: Hormone therapy, such as tamoxifen or aromatase inhibitors, is often used to treat ER+/PR+ breast cancer. These drugs work by blocking the effects of estrogen and progesterone on cancer cells, helping to slow or stop tumor growth.
